summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of wrapping the tallit over the left shoulder after reciting the blessing. He compares the Halabi custom described by Hakham Yosef Abadi Shayo and Hakham Rahamim Moshe Shayo with the instructions provided by the Ben Ish Hai.
